topic: A student is accused of plagiarism
text: Walking through the empty halls, I can't shake the echo of the words that hung in the air, heavy and cold. The whispers of what's been said about me, about my work, they swirl around, almost like they have a life of their own. I remember the nights, the long, tireless hours poured into each sentence, each word chosen with care. It’s hard to look at the distrust in the eyes that once held respect, hard to breathe when the walls of my efforts feel like they are closing in. I wish I could turn back, find a moment where the path could have split differently, where shadows of suspicion didn’t mark the journey.
